mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.2% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing near-term inflation expectations and prompting the Fed to delay rate hikes, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.2% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which triggers a policy response from the Fed to prevent a recession, leading to lower long-term yields and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST < 950 and RSAFS < 375000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of Fed rate cuts, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO < 110.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.04 in 70% of rolling 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 375,000 million dollars, combined with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 950,000 units, indicates a severe demand shock that triggers a coordinated fiscal and monetary policy response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: severe demand shock with policy response
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS < 375000 and HOUST < 950 (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% over a 3-month period signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity cash flows, reducing valuation multiples and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal has Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 138,000 thousand persons, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.0%), signals a strong labor market that increases inflation expectations and pressures the Fed to maintain high rates, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS > 138000 and UNRATE < 5.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal has Rank IC > -0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 11690 billion dollars, observed on a quarterly basis, indicates a recessionary risk that triggers a policy response, leading to lower long-term yields and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 < 11690 (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.04 in 70% of rolling 3-year windows.
